 UP Board Exam Timings and Shifts 2027 
 The UP Board has released the examination schedule for Class 10 (High School) and Class 12 (Intermediate) for 2027. According to the official announcement, the examinations will begin on February 5, 2027 , and conclude on February 24, 2027. 
 The examination cycle is scheduled to be completed within 20 days. Students appearing for the High School and Intermediate examinations should review the schedule and plan their revision accordingly.  UP Board Exam Timings and Shifts 2027
 The UP Board examinations will be conducted in two shifts: morning and evening. Students will receive 15 minutes to read the question paper before beginning to write their answers.
 Practising UP Board Class 10 previous year question papers can also help students become familiar with question formats and improve time management.
